sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Column-header count badges (the unique-value count before 📊 and the ▶N▤ multi-row count) are now memoized per table and only recomputed when the set of visible rows actually changes. Sorting a column, clearing a filter back to a row set already seen, and showing/hiding a column all reuse the previous result instead of re-running an O(rows × columns) scan — on a 4174-row, 21-column page that scan is roughly 88 000 cell-text extractions. Implements PERFORMANCE.org Step 3.
The cache key is deliberately order-independent, so re-sorting a column is a cache hit: a sort changes row order and never the row set, and the counts do not depend on order.

A scan that is superseded part-way through no longer records its partial result as the cached answer, so the columns it never reached are recomputed by the next pass instead of keeping a stale number for as long as the row set stays put.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The Locality→Region correction applied to flag-decorated area cells (which lands up to six seconds after the render, once a third-party flag userscript has decorated them) now invalidates the affected table's cached column data. Previously the unique-values dropdown and the column-header counts could keep serving values read before the correction moved them between columns.
